sections.title: Setup & baseline
sections.note: Do this once before testing. Local DB and storage should be the production copy from 2026-09-30.

items.text: Local DB and storage/app are the production snapshot (rollback point exists)
composer install, npm run build, php artisan optimize:clear done; public/build is current and committed
storage/app/.glide-cache exists and is writable
You have an admin login, and ideally a second non-admin user to test access rules
Test browsers ready: Chrome, Safari, Firefox desktop, plus iOS Safari and one Android browser

sections.title: Public site: global
sections.note: Check in all three languages (de / fr / en).

items.text: /, /de, /fr, /en and /{de,fr,en}/home load with status 200
<html lang> matches the current language on every page type
Language switcher D / E / F keeps you on the same page (team, member, assistant, contact); active language is highlighted
Localized slugs work: /de/kontakt, /fr/contacter, /en/contact, /de/team-vogt/assistenz, /fr/team-luks/assistence
Unknown URL shows the styled 404 page with status 404 (not 500)
Logo links to the home page in the current language
Desktop menu: Team Luks, Team Vogt and Kontakt links work; team dropdowns open
Mobile menu (below 900 px): burger opens and closes, team submenus expand, “Über uns” and member links work
Team member submenu lists only published members, in the admin order, plus “Assistenz”
No console errors and no failed requests on any page (fonts, CSS, JS from /build)
Favicons, apple-touch-icon and site.webmanifest load
jQuery plugins run: lazysizes loads images on scroll, simplebar scroll columns, swipers
Page titles and meta descriptions present (home, team, member uses SEO Beschreibung)
Side-by-side with production at 1280 px and 375 px: layout, fonts and spacing look identical
Hero image shows with its saved crop applied
items.hint: Previously the hero ignored the crop.

items.text: Hero switches source at 900 / 1200 / 1600 px widths; network shows AVIF or WebP
Scroll arrow on the hero scrolls down to the text
Title and text render; headings, bold, lists and links look like production
Team text shows in the scrollable column
Desktop images: vertical swiper with prev / next when more than one image
Below 900 px: horizontal swiper with the mobile images
Unpublished images do not appear
Open every member page in all three languages (/team-{team}/{name}/{id})
On a tall window (height ≥ 900 px) the member image loads
items.hint: Was a broken image on production (HTTP 400).

items.text: Crops anchored at the top-left corner are now applied; compare with production
items.hint: 6 saved crops were ignored before (1 contact, 3 team, 2 member images).

items.text: Info, Beschreibung, Tätigkeitsgebiete, Sprachen, Werdegang, Mitgliedschaften and both Publikationen blocks show when filled and hide when empty
Publication articles appear in admin order; unpublished ones are hidden
Assistenz pages for both teams show description, list and images
Kontakt shows address, Google Maps link, Impressum, Datenschutz and images
Datenschutz in FR and EN shows the translated text once entered in the admin (falls back to German while empty)

sections.title: Image delivery (Glide)
sections.note: Watch the network tab. The first request of each variant renders it (up to ~0.7 s for AVIF); later ones come from cache.

items.text: Image requests return 200 as AVIF, WebP and JPG (Safari / older browsers fall back correctly)
Files match the requested slot size, not always 2400 px
items.hint: E.g. a 900×600 slot downloads ~900 px wide.

items.text: Framing of every cropped image matches production
/img/original/… and /img/thumbnail/… work (admin previews use them)
A crop URL with a non-whitelisted size or format is rejected instead of rendered
Reloading a page serves images quickly from the Glide cache
/login: wrong password shows an error; correct login lands in /administration
Logged out, /administration and any sub-URL redirect to login
Logged out, /api/home returns 401 JSON
A user without the admin role cannot open the admin (403)
Registration and password reset are disabled (/register, /password/reset)
Logout in the sidebar ends the session; browser back does not show admin data or allow saving
With an expired session (delete the session cookie), the next save shows a clear message or sends you to login
Passwort ändern (click your name): mismatch and fewer than 6 characters show validation; a valid change works and the new password logs in
Dashboard shows “Willkommen” with your name
Sidebar links Home, Teams, Kontakt, Dateien work; current item is highlighted
Reloading any admin URL directly (list, edit form, create form) opens that screen
Browser back / forward between list and form works
At phone width the menu opens from the header, closes with the arrow and after navigating
Success and error notifications appear and disappear
All icons render (Phosphor); no empty buttons
Unknown admin URL (e.g. /administration/foo): note what happens
/forbidden and /not-found error views render
Homepage list loads; eye icon toggles publish and the public site follows
Delete asks for confirmation; cancel keeps the entry, confirm removes it
Create a new entry, save, and find it in the list
Saving without Titel shows the message and marks the field (422)
Language tabs DE / FR / EN switch Titel and Text; each language saves separately
“Publizieren?” radio saves
Save shows a notification; reload shows the saved values; public page updated
Images: upload, “Vorschau” label and 1:1 crop, captions DE / FR / EN, eye toggle, delete (see Image manager section for details)
Teams list: toggle, edit, delete with confirmation, create
Team form: Team select (Luks / Vogt), Titel* and Text* required in DE, FR / EN optional, publish
Team images with Desktop / Mobile and translated captions; desktop caption info text shows
Members are grouped by team
Eye toggle inside the draggable list works
Drag a member to a new position; reload: order kept; public menu shows new order
items.hint: Native drag-and-drop could not be tested automatically.

items.text: Edit, delete with confirmation, create
Assistenz list: toggle, edit, delete with confirmation, create
Vorname*, Name*, Team* required; missing values show messages
Info, Beschreibung, SEO Beschreibung, Tätigkeitsgebiete, Sprachen, Werdegang, Mitgliedschaften, Publikationen (Liste) save in DE / FR / EN
Changing the name updates the public URL and the member menu
Images with Desktop (10:12) / Mobile (3:2), single caption, publish, delete
Create a publication from the member form; Titel* required in DE; Beschreibung and Artikel save per language
Edit, publish toggle, delete with confirmation; back link returns to the member
Drag publications into a new order; reload: kept; public page shows new order
items.hint: Native drag-and-drop could not be tested automatically.

items.text: Team* required; Beschreibung and Assistenten save per language; publish
Images with Desktop / Mobile, caption, crop, delete
Kontakt list: toggle, edit, delete with confirmation, create
Adresse (DE) / Text (FR, EN), Impressum, Datenschutz, Google Maps Uri save per language
Enter the client’s Datenschutz texts in FR and EN; check the public FR / EN contact page
Images with Desktop / Mobile, caption, crop, delete

sections.title: Admin: Image manager
sections.note: Run fully once (e.g. Team member), then spot-check Home, Team, Assistenz and Kontakt.

items.text: Upload PNG, JPG and JPEG by drag-and-drop and by click; several files at once
GIF / PDF and files over 8 MB are rejected with a message that says why
On a new, unsaved record: upload images first, then save; images and order stay with the record
Pencil opens the overlay; caption fields save; caption shows on the preview; close with button, ✕ and Escape
“Anwendung” switches Desktop / Mobile and the public page puts the image in the right slot
Crop opens on the saved crop (same frame as before)
Cropper ratio matches: Desktop 10:12, Mobile 3:2, Vorschau 1:1, Home default 16:10; Desktop / Mobile buttons switch it
Save crop; public page shows the new framing; Abbrechen discards
Eye toggle hides the image on the public page
Delete asks for confirmation and removes the image
Image icon opens the cropped image in a new tab
Grid / Listen Ansicht toggle works
In list view, drag images into a new order; reload: kept; public swiper follows
items.hint: Native drag-and-drop could not be tested automatically.

sections.title: Admin: Rich-text editor (Tiptap)
sections.note: TinyMCE was replaced. Test fully in one form, then spot-check one editor in every form.

items.text: Open three long texts (a Werdegang, Kontakt Datenschutz, Home text), save without changes: public page looks the same
Texts pasted from Word / Outlook earlier now use the site font (inline fonts removed)
Forms with many editors (member form, language tabs) load fast and keep each editor’s content separate
Rückgängig / Wiederholen
Überschrift 1, 2, 3 and back to paragraph; active state shows
Fett
Liste and Nummerierte Liste; toggling off works; output matches public list style
Hochgestellt
Kleine Schrift renders small on the public page
Worttrennung deaktivieren keeps the words together on the public page
Formatierung entfernen
Link type URL; “open in new tab” checkbox sets target
Link type E-Mail creates a mailto: link
Link type Telefon creates a tel: link
Link type Datei: pick an uploaded PDF; upload a new file from inside the dialog
Edit and remove an existing link; Titel (optional) is kept
Paste from Word / a web page: junk styles are dropped, structure stays
Enter, Shift+Enter line break, Cmd/Ctrl+B and Cmd/Ctrl+Z behave as expected
Upload a PDF; it appears in the list and opens
Non-PDF files and PDFs over 16 MB are rejected with a reason
Delete removes the entry
items.hint: Known: the file itself stays on disk (unchanged behaviour).

items.text: New file is available in the editor link dialog under Datei
Double-clicking Save does not create duplicates
With network throttled to “Slow 4G”, loading indicators show and nothing breaks
With APP_DEBUG=false, a server error shows the styled error page, no stack trace
Umlauts, «Guillemets», & and long words save and display correctly in all fields

sections.title: Deploy & production smoke test
sections.note: After go-live on the production server.

items.text: Snapshot production DB and storage/
PHP 8.3+ for CLI and FPM; Imagick with AVIF and WebP available
.env: APP_URL, SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS, SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE, APP_DEBUG=false, mail settings
git pull, composer install --no-dev, php artisan optimize:clear
storage/app/.glide-cache created and writable by the web server
Home, both teams, one member, assistant and contact load in de / fr / en with images
Admin login, one text edit, one image upload + crop, then revert
storage/logs shows no new errors after the smoke test
Once stable, remove the old image cache storage/app/public/cache/
